title: Grateful Dead Live at Hara Arena on 1981-11-30
lineage: XLII > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 & tagged. May 2013
source: Source: AUD 2nd-Gen (MAC > C > C), unknown equipment.

ai_review.summary: Stellar front‑of‑house recording captures a white‑hot second set that’s a must‑have for any Dead collection
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling the second set “white hot” and describing the show as a personal favorite. The front‑of‑house (FOB) tape is praised for its crystal‑clear clarity, making this recording both musically and technically superb.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently highlight an outstanding performance and excellent FOB sound quality, indicating a near‑perfect show and recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the FOB (front‑of‑house) tape as “stellar” with outstanding clarity; no issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set is singled out as a highlight, and the overall concert left a lasting emotional impact on attendees.
